schema.text: Who would it help most? (Select all that apply)

options.text: People with a pushchair or a shopping trolley
Older people or people who walk with difficulty
Children and young people, for example on the way to school
People on a bike or e-scooter

en.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: Who would it help most? (Select all that apply)
en.#People with a pushchair or a shopping t: People with a pushchair or a shopping trolley
en.#Older people or people who walk with di: Older people or people who walk with difficulty
en.#Children and young people, for example: Children and young people, for example on the way to school
en.#People on a bike or e-scooter: People on a bike or e-scooter

it.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: A chi sarebbe più utile? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#People with a pushchair or a shopping t: Persone con passeggino o carrello della spesa
it.#Older people or people who walk with di: Anziani o persone che camminano con difficoltà
it.#Children and young people, for example: Bambini e ragazzi, per esempio nel tragitto casa–scuola

fr.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: À qui cela serait-il le plus utile ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#People with a pushchair or a shopping t: Personnes avec une poussette ou un chariot de courses
fr.#Older people or people who walk with di: Personnes âgées ou personnes qui marchent avec difficulté
fr.#Children and young people, for example: Enfants et jeunes, par exemple sur le chemin de l’école
fr.#People on a bike or e-scooter: Personnes à vélo ou en trottinette
fr.#Everyone in the same way: Tout le monde de la même façon

de.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: Wem würde es am meisten helfen? (Alle zutreffenden Antworten auswählen)
de.#Older people or people who walk with di: Ältere Menschen oder Menschen, die nur mühsam gehen
de.#Children and young people, for example: Kinder und Jugendliche, zum Beispiel auf dem Schulweg

tr.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: En çok kime yardımcı olur? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#People with a pushchair or a shopping t: Bebek arabası veya alışveriş arabasıyla gezenler
tr.#Blind or partially sighted people: Görme engelli veya az gören kişiler
tr.#Children and young people, for example: Çocuklar ve gençler, örneğin okul yolunda

fa.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: بیشتر به چه کسانی کمک می‌کند؟ (همه موارد مناسب را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#People with a pushchair or a shopping t: افراد با کالسکه یا چرخ خرید
fa.#Older people or people who walk with di: سالمندان یا افرادی که به‌سختی راه می‌روند
fa.#Children and young people, for example: کودکان و نوجوانان، برای مثال در مسیر مدرسه
fa.#People on a bike or e-scooter: افراد با دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی

hu.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: Kinek segítene a legtöbbet? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#Children and young people, for example: Gyerekeknek és fiataloknak, például az iskolába menet

ar.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: مَن سيستفيد منه أكثر؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#People with a pushchair or a shopping t: مَن يدفعون عربة أطفال أو عربة تسوّق
ar.#Older people or people who walk with di: كبار السن أو مَن يمشون بصعوبة
ar.#Children and young people, for example: الأطفال والشباب، مثلًا في الطريق إلى المدرسة

pl.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: Komu najbardziej by to pomogło? (Zaznacz wszystkie pasujące odpowiedzi)
pl.#People with a pushchair or a shopping t: Osobom z wózkiem dziecięcym lub wózkiem na zakupy
pl.#Older people or people who walk with di: Osobom starszym lub mającym trudności z chodzeniem
pl.#Children and young people, for example: Dzieciom i młodzieży, na przykład w drodze do szkoły
pl.#People on a bike or e-scooter: Osobom na rowerze lub hulajnodze elektrycznej

da.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: Hvem ville det hjælpe mest? (Vælg alle relevante)
da.#Older people or people who walk with di: Ældre eller personer, der går med besvær
da.#Children and young people, for example: Børn og unge, for eksempel på vej til skole

lb.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: Wiem géif et am meeschten hëllefen? (Wielt all déi zoutreffend Äntwerten)
lb.#Older people or people who walk with di: Eeler Leit oder Leit, déi schwéier ginn
lb.#Children and young people, for example: Kanner a Jonker, zum Beispill um Schoulwee

nl.#Who would it help most? (Select all tha: Wie zou er het meest mee geholpen zijn? (Selecteer alles wat van toepassing is)
nl.#People with a pushchair or a shopping t: Mensen met een kinderwagen of boodschappenkar
nl.#Older people or people who walk with di: Ouderen of mensen die moeilijk lopen
nl.#Children and young people, for example: Kinderen en jongeren, bijvoorbeeld op weg naar school
nl.#People on a bike or e-scooter: Mensen op de fiets of e-step
